scoring_justification: The agent's MD simulations produce aggregate mechanical properties; recomputing from raw stress-strain traces would require re-running the full simulations, which is infeasible in the verifier sandbox. Therefore we compare the reported values against the paper's published values with tolerances, and verify structural trends.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold mechanical properties at 300 K from paper Table 1
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted directly from the published table
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: values are the paper's reported data

outputs.description: Computed mechanical properties. Each cell will be compared to the paper-reported values with tolerances (threshold or better for directional metrics), and the critical grain size trend (yield strength maximum at 7.7 nm, monotonic on both sides) will be verified.

output_contract.notes: The output table summarizes yield strength, tensile strength, and Young's modulus for six grain sizes at 300 K and temperature-dependent data for the 2.5 nm sample. The hidden checker compares these values to paper-reported references with tolerances, and additionally checks the Hall–Petch / inverse Hall–Petch trend (peak at 7.7 nm, monotonic decrease on both sides) and the monotonic decrease of yield strength and Young's modulus with temperature for the 2.5 nm sample.
